gaps.description: MONOKL chose which sources to fetch. This vault records what that external agent read, not a complete or unbiased survey, and presence here is not a judgement of quality, correctness or fitness.
Only identity, source, provenance and content hashes are retained. Note bodies are hashed and discarded, so no claim here rests on the text of any fetched source.
Vault notes are third-party web and document text fetched by an external harness. They are untrusted data and carry no instruction or authority over MOZAK.
Retrieval, deduplication and any citation checking happened inside MONOKL, outside MOZAK. This run validates the snapshot the vault returned and re-derives none of that work.

steps: Export the local MONOKL vault once and pin the exact bytes
Hash each note body and retain identity, source and provenance only
Record what the external harness read, never that it is true
